• My team does monitor and L2 Engineer Level troubleshooting to investigate all the alerts and validate them and if not, we route these

Call ISP to work in WAN issues.

• Also have some knowledge on Netbrain as one of the clients uses Netbrain to access their network devices. We usually use Secret Server to Access 
Password and client details. We also use Jump server and Putty to access network devices. 
• Have worked with Palo Alto Panorama, we also push most of the policies and changes to PA firewall from Panorama. Have some go od basic knowledge
